## Work

Give the title and edition or translation. Add the Open Christian Data ID if you know it.

For a new acquisition, use the queue cataloging template in
`docs/examples/information-templates.md#acquisition-queue-cataloging`.

## Public source

Link the source and identify the exact page, section, or record that supports the proposal.

## Proposed change

Are you suggesting a source, offering to reconstruct or review this text, or submitting work for review? Describe the edition and scope you can help with. Add the acquisition-list ID or an existing issue when known.

For a correction, identify the passage or metadata field and the evidence for the change. Include relevant reuse terms and requested source credits. Other ideas are welcome; explain what they would help people do.

## Work and evidence

If work has started, link the candidate and the evidence described in the text contribution guide. State which independent checks and source comparisons were completed, what remains uncertain, and whether another contributor is already working on this copy.

## Credit

How should we credit you if the proposal is accepted? This is optional.
